indexes_at_measurement.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_items_pk ON olist.order_items USING btree (order_id, order_item_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_reviews_pk ON olist.order_reviews USING btree (review_id, order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON olist.orders USING btree (order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sellers_pkey ON olist.sellers USING btree (seller_id)

verification.method: Independent Python item-price accumulation, seller/order sets and review selection

benchmark.method: perf_counter: SQLAlchemy execute and full result fetch on one connection
benchmark.cache: warm; no cache flush; no concurrency load

question: Q4 top sellers by completed merchandise sales with preparation and review proxies

semantics.scope: delivered orders by purchase timestamp, start inclusive/end exclusive
semantics.revenue: seller's own SUM(item price), nominal BRL, excluding freight/payments
semantics.ranking: revenue descending, seller_id ascending for ties; exact top_n cap
semantics.averaging_grain: one seller/order pair, irrespective of item/review count
semantics.preparation: (carrier handoff timestamp - approval timestamp) in fractional days
semantics.preparation_validity: own validity flag, both dates and nonnegative interval; zero is valid
semantics.missing_preparation: seller revenue retained, duration excluded from average with count
semantics.review_selection: latest answer, then creation, then review_id descending, same as Q3
semantics.missing_review: seller revenue retained, score average excludes NULL with coverage count
semantics.multi_seller_limit: preparation timestamp and review score describe the whole order, not individual seller performance

scope: Q4 initial measurement only; no new indexes, views or other questions
